subject.title: ci: harden HTTP and local-auth gates against transient failures

question: Should this remain one coordinated CI hardening issue, or should the HTTP fixture and local-auth saturation work be split into separately owned implementation tracks?
rationale: The failure modes are independent and cross CI configuration, external dependency handling, Playwright behavior, runner provisioning, and application query load; a maintainer must set ownership and sequencing before changes begin.

options.title: Split implementation tracks
options.body: Keep this issue as the coordinating report while assigning separate HTTP-fixture and local-auth capacity/load changes with independent validation.

options.title: Use one coordinated change
options.body: Assign one owner to deliver both failure-mode fixes and the full repeated-run acceptance suite together.

recommendation.title: Split implementation tracks
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the coordinating report while assigning separate HTTP-fixture and local-auth capacity/load changes with independent validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged ownership of adjacent CI smoke and local-auth infrastructure makes this person the best available coordinator for the initial scope decision.
